title: Worlds
deleteWorldHint: Only a world no game was ever played in can be deleted, with its scenarios and catalogues.

form.referenceHint: Lower-case letters, digits and underscores. It never changes once the world is created.
form.toneHint: One line, in English, for both arbitration and narration.
form.rulesHint: What is possible in this world, in English. Read by arbitration only.
form.ambianceHint: Sensory material for the narrator, in English.
form.skillsHint: In percent, as in BRP. Each has a category and the chance an untrained character has in it: a fixed chance, or a characteristic times a multiplier (Dodge is DEX × 2).
form.glossaryHint: Proper names that are no person nor place of the game — factions, figures off stage — and their translations.

actionTypes.intro: Arbitration picks a category for each action; the skill or the characteristic tied to it is rolled.
actionTypes.empty: No category yet: no action could be rolled.
actionTypes.descriptionHint: One sentence in English, read by arbitration.

fixErrors: Some fields need fixing: see below each of them.
